title: Let's Learn English Lesson 24
subtitle: Yesterday Was Amazing!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 24: Yesterday Was Amazing! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yesterday was the most amazing day. I want to tell my friend back home about it. So, I am writing her a letter!
dialogue.zh: 昨天是最棒的一天。我想告诉老家的朋友。所以，我正在给她写信！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Dear Penelope, Life in Washington, D.C. is interesting. I see something new every day -- like yesterday. Yesterday started like a usual work day.
dialogue.zh: 亲爱的佩内洛普：华盛顿特区的生活很有意思。我每天都会看到新东西——比如昨天。昨天开始时像平常的工作日。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I said, "Yesterday started like a usual work day."
dialogue.zh: 我说：“昨天开始时像平常的工作日。”

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: I was at work. And I wanted a break. So, I walked and walked … and walked. Then, I saw something! It was a festival -- a big festival!
dialogue.zh: 我在上班。我想休息一下。所以我走啊走……又走。然后，我看到了什么！那是一个节日——一个很大的节日！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It is the Smithsonian Folklife Festival.
dialogue.zh: 这是史密森民俗生活节。

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: Yes. It was the Smithsonian Folklife Festival. Every year the festival shows different cultures. This year one of the cultures was the Basque culture. There was dancing and food and games!
dialogue.zh: 对。那是史密森民俗生活节。每年这个节日都会展示不同的文化。今年其中一种是巴斯克文化。有舞蹈、食物和游戏！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am dancing a traditional Basque dance.
dialogue.zh: 我在跳传统的巴斯克舞。

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: At the festival, I danced a traditional Basque dance!
dialogue.zh: 在节日上，我跳了传统的巴斯克舞！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They are cooking traditional Basque food.
dialogue.zh: 他们在做传统的巴斯克食物。

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: They cooked a lot of traditional Basque food.
dialogue.zh: 他们做了很多传统的巴斯克食物。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They are playing a game. It's a kind of handball. What do they call it? They call it pilota!
dialogue.zh: 他们在玩游戏。那是一种手球。他们叫它什么？他们叫它皮洛塔！

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: They played a game with their hands and a small ball. It's a kind of handball. But this game is called pilota.
dialogue.zh: 他们用手和一个小球玩游戏。那是一种手球。不过这个游戏叫皮洛塔。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is beautiful! This is traditional Basque art.
dialogue.zh: 这真美！这是传统的巴斯克艺术。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They are making a traditional Basque ship. This festival is a lot of fun!
dialogue.zh: 他们在做一艘传统的巴斯克船。这个节日很好玩！

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: The whole day was a lot of fun!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Who said that? I want to write my friends and tell them about my day!
dialogue.zh: 谁说的？我想写信给朋友们，告诉他们我的一天！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: … So, I wanted to tell you about my day! Please, my friend, come visit Washington, D.C. soon. There is a lot to do! Until next time … Anna.
dialogue.zh: ……所以，我想告诉你我的一天！朋友，请尽快来华盛顿特区玩。这里有很多事可以做！下次见……安娜。

quiz.prompt: What festival did Anna see yesterday?
Which culture did the festival show?
What is the handball game called?
